I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I said I'd noted that the deadline for the signed order form at Tamsin Cold Chain is 24 September, and that I hadn't changed anything, as she asked.

I also pointed out that 24 September was three weeks before today (14 October). If that date is right, the deadline may already have been missed. Last, I suggested she correct her post in #north-team herself, because I only replied in #north-random and didn't edit or read that channel.
